description: MoYuan's strong trail as black ink: the red ribbon goes black, its glowing red line is dimmed to a faint crimson, the stroke's edge is dark crimson. Each write starts one slot early (the 1.0 kept) so it matches once; only the red slot of each baked color is written: script constants are shared, the zeros next to it may be used elsewhere. The bandit JinYe's blood trail as black ink (light attacks): its blood materials' tint goes near black and their red edge off, like the in-game test of 06.11 the user liked.
